list.name: contratista
list.label: Contratista
list.query: SELECT id as __value, razon_social as __text FROM contratistas_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true ORDER BY razon_social

list.name: area
list.label: Área
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre as __text FROM areas_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) ORDER BY nombre

list.name: usuario
list.label: Usuario
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre_completo as __text FROM usuarios_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true ORDER BY nombre_completo

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_activo = true) AS activos FROM formularios
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM form_responses fr WHERE (0 IN (${usuario:csv}) OR fr.usuario_id IN (${usuario:csv}))
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN completado THEN 100 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS completitud FROM form_responses fr WHERE (0 IN (${usuario:csv}) OR fr.usuario_id IN (${usuario:csv}))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM formularios f WHERE f.estado_activo = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM form_responses fr WHERE fr.formulario_id = f.id AND (0 IN (${usuario:csv}) OR fr.usuario_id IN (${usuario:csv})))

SELECT f.nombre AS formulario, COUNT(fr.id) AS respuestas, COUNT(fr.id) FILTER (WHERE fr.completado = true) AS completadas FROM formularios f LEFT JOIN form_responses fr ON f.id = fr.formulario_id WHERE f.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${usuario:csv}) OR fr.usuario_id IN (${usuario:csv})) GROUP BY f.nombre ORDER BY respuestas DESC

SELECT f.nombre AS formulario, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fr.completado = true)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1) AS completitud_pct FROM formularios f LEFT JOIN form_responses fr ON f.id = fr.formulario_id WHERE f.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${usuario:csv}) OR fr.usuario_id IN (${usuario:csv})) GROUP BY f.nombre ORDER BY completitud_pct DESC

SELECT um.nombre_completo AS usuario, COUNT(fr.id) AS respuestas FROM form_responses fr LEFT JOIN usuarios_mirror um ON fr.usuario_id = um.id WHERE (0 IN (${usuario:csv}) OR fr.usuario_id IN (${usuario:csv})) GROUP BY um.nombre_completo ORDER BY respuestas DESC

SELECT am.nombre AS area, COUNT(fr.id) AS respuestas FROM form_responses fr LEFT JOIN expedientes e ON fr.expediente_id = e.id LEFT JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id LEFT JOIN areas_mirror am ON p.area_id = am.id WHERE (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) GROUP BY am.nombre ORDER BY respuestas DESC
